unit.why: Homiletic discussion, quoting Bnei Yissaschar and Derekh Pikudekha, on the revelation of Elijah and on not seeking spiritual ranks. The Talmudic Abaye/Rava anecdote appears only as a brief proof-text inside the exegesis, not as a standalone narrative.
unit.boundary_note: Continues the teaching section on the revelation of Elijah from the previous division. Ends with the heading 'מענין גמילות חסדים', which introduces the next section.
